t: You're on Blomfield Road, in Maida Vale, running along the northern bank of the Regent's Canal in Little Venice. The road branches west off the A5, with Randolph Avenue and Warwick Avenue heading north from it. Then it turns sharply north to follow the canal until it meets Formosa Street. It's named after Charles James Blomfield, who lived from 1786 to 1857. He was a classicist and Church of England bishop, serving as Bishop of London.
